results.content: ## [Literature Review] Dictionary-free Koopman Predictive Control for Autonomous Vehicles in Mixed Traffic. AISimplify autonomous vehicle control in mixed traffic: This dictionary-free Koopman MPC learns automatically, adapting to dynamic conditions without manual tuning. This paper introduces a Dictionary-Free Koopman Model Predictive Control (DF-KMPC) for controlling Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) in mixed traffic environments. The key idea is to create a data-driven representation of an approximated Koopman linear model for the mixed traffic system, drawing inspiration from an extended Willems' fundamental lemma. The challenge with the Koopman operator is choosing the right lifting functions, while Willems' lemma requires updating the model when the traffic equilibrium changes.
